story.title: The Story of T.A Coin
story.paragraph1: Following the upward trend of the global crypto-assets business, the TA was named from the Techo International Airport, and to memorize its grand opening moment of the world 9th largest airport in Cambodia.
story.paragraph2: It was the great time for the establishment of the TA Coin Company in 2025 in considering of the new airport operations which fund raising is the key matter to support their working capital. To tackle all the challenges of raising fund either from the debt or equity markets overseas as the main covenants are all located in Cambodia, we "TA Coin" will be the key partner in collecting funds from investors who are interested in the new airport investments including the property development in its surrounding areas. Potentially, the investment will be further funds the future expansion of the Phase 2 and the Phase 3 of the new airport.
story.paragraph3: With the brilliant ideas from our key shareholders, the crypto-assets business will bring in crypto experts and transfer the expertise to Cambodia young generation, providing them a chance to learn new things and continuous strengthening their crypto related skills to welcome and be ready to the crypto growing markets.

knowhow.title: Full Know-how of the Financial Industry
knowhow.body: The shareholders, directors and management team of the T.A Coin have an in-depth industry knowledge in crypto-asset and financial services sectors. We provide confidence to investors in safeguarding and managing their investment assets with professional and care.

exposure.title: Crypto-asset Exposure
exposure.bullet1: Creating the accessibility of the crypto-asset investment available from the local and reputational company with peg values tied to assets in Cambodia as required by law.
exposure.bullet2: Opportunity for investors who plan to diversify their portfolios to include crypto-asset investment.

disclosures.title: Full Disclosures
disclosures.bullet1: Annual financial audits reports will be published online after it has been approved by the Audit Committee and the Board of Directors.
disclosures.bullet2: The peg values report will be available online after certified by the independent party designated by the Board of Directors.

compliance.title: Regulatory Compliance and Professionalism
compliance.bullet1: In addition to the regulatory bodies, our internal Compliance Team ensures full compliance in every aspect of the business.
compliance.bullet2: Our expertise follows the industry professionals in securing the transactions and investments of the clients by clarifying any potential risk that may relate to their portfolios and ensure they are well-informed before joining us.
compliance.bullet3: Investor's assets are securely stored and re-invested in legitimate, viable and high credit projects in Cambodia.
compliance.bullet4: We are the first qualified Coin Issuer and Crypto-asset Service Providers (CASPs) licensing by the National Bank of Cambodia (the NBC) and the approval from the Cambodia Securities Exchange (CSX).

profit.title: Profit Sharing
profit.body: Profits from investment will be shared among investors as a form of Coin incentives or Coin dividends.

sustainability.title: Social & Sustainability
sustainability.description: People and environment highly matter, we operate our business which aims to produce positive impacts to our community, our nature, in this regard, we would share our profitability as a part of the contribution to the environment, economy, and society, in particular to the territories where our business activities are conducting.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro1: This Privacy Policy describes how T.A COIN CO., LTD. ("TA COIN") collects, uses, stores, and protects your personal information when you use our platform (Mobile App or/and Web App). We are committed to protecting your privacy and handling your data responsibly.
privacy.intro2: You are required to carefully read this document and accepted it. If you do not agree with this Privacy Policy, then you must refrain from using our Web App (website), Mobile App and/or Services or registering an Account with us. This Privacy Policy is an integral part of our Terms of Use.

acceptance.title: Acceptance of the Privacy Policy Terms
acceptance.body1: By using our Web App (website), Mobile App and signing in/up for our services, clicking the confirm-checkbox, you provide us an explicit consent to terms and the data practices described in this Policy and in the Terms of Use including the processing, storage, and usage of your personal data.
acceptance.body2: From time to time, TA COIN may revise and update this Privacy Policy to reflect changes in legislation or review our personal data collection and processing practices. If any changes, amendments and additions are made to this Privacy Policy, they would come into force and be applied immediately after they are published on the Website.

section1.title: 1. Introduction to Our Privacy Commitment
section1.body: In the TA Coin Platforms (App & Web App), we understand the importance of your personal privacy. In accordance with Cambodia's regulatory requirements and our internal policies, we are dedicated to adhering to the spirit of privacy protection. This policy aims to be transparent about our data practices and empower you to make informed decisions about your information.

section2.title: 2. Information We Collect
section2.intro: We may collect various types of information from and about you when you use our TA Coin platforms (App & WebApp), depending on the features you use.
section2.subDirectTitle: 2.1. Information You Provide Directly to Us

subDirect.accountBody: When you create an account, we collect your name, email address, phone number, and a secure password.
subDirect.kycBody: To comply with financial regulations and prevent fraud, we may require you to provide government-issued identification documents (e.g., National ID card, passport), your photograph (including a "selfie" for liveness detection), and other relevant identification details.
subDirect.financialBody: This may include bank account details, mobile money account details, and transaction history within the App/Web App.
subDirect.communicationBody: Records of your communications with us, such as customer support inquiries, disputes resolution inquiries and so on.
subDirect.userContentBody: Any information you submit through the App/Web App, such as feedback or participation in surveys, campaigns and others.

subAuto.deviceBody: We collect information about your mobile device, including the device model, operating system version, unique device identifiers, mobile network information, and crash data.
subAuto.usageBody: We collect information about how you use the App/Web App, such as the features you access, the time and date of your activities, and app crashes.
subAuto.locationBody: With your explicit consent, we may collect precise or approximate location information from your mobile/tablet device.
subAuto.logBody: Standard log data, including IP address, browser type, and referring/exit pages.
subAuto.transactionBody: Information and balance of the trading, deposit, withdrawal, and other transactions.

section2.subThirdBody: We may receive information about you from third-party service providers (e.g., identity verification services, payment processors) when necessary to provide our services.

section3.title: 3. How We Use Your Information
section3.item1: To Provide and Maintain Our Services
section3.item2: For Security, Fraud Prevention, AML and CTF

section5.title: 5. Data Retention
section5.body: We will retain your personal information for as long as necessary to fulfill the purposes outlined in this Privacy Policy, unless a longer retention period is required or permitted by law.

section6.title: 6. Data Security
section6.body: We implement reasonable technical and organizational measures to protect your personal information, including encryption, access controls, regular security audits, and employee training.

section8.title: 8. Children's Privacy
section8.body: TA Coin Platforms are not intended for use by individuals under the age of 18. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children under 18.

section9.title: 9. Changes to This Privacy Policy
section9.body: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. We will notify you of any material changes by posting the updated Privacy Policy on our App/WebApp.

terms.title: Terms and Conditions
terms.welcome: Welcome to T.A Coin. These Terms and Conditions govern your use of our digital platform and services.

section4.title: 4. Regulatory Status & Investor Eligibility

section9.title: 9. User Conduct

section11.title: 11. Risk Disclosure
